definitions.explanation: the distribution of water through pipes and infrastructure to homes and facilities

examples.japanese: {配水|はいすい}{管|かん}が{古|ふる}くなっている。
examples.english: The water distribution pipes are getting old.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}で{配水|はいすい}システムが{損傷|そんしょう}した。
examples.english: The water distribution system was damaged by the earthquake.

examples.japanese: {市|し}は{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}した{配水|はいすい}{施設|しせつ}の{更新|こうしん}{工事|こうじ}を{計画|けいかく}している。
examples.english: The city is planning renovation work on the aging water distribution facilities.

notes:
Refers to the process and infrastructure of distributing clean water to homes and buildings. This is the supply side of the water system — getting water from treatment plants to consumers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配水|はいすい}{管|かん}: water distribution pipe
- {配水|はいすい}{池|ち}: distribution reservoir
- {配水|はいすい}{施設|しせつ}: water distribution facility
- {配水|はいすい}{量|りょう}: volume of water distributed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {排水|はいすい}: drainage — same pronunciation but opposite direction; removing used water. Written with {排|はい} (expel) instead of {配|はい} (distribute)
- {給水|きゅうすい}: water supply — focuses on providing water to a specific point, often temporary (e.g., emergency water supply)
- {上水|じょうすい}: clean water/tap water — the water itself rather than the distribution process
- {水道|すいどう}: water service/waterworks — the broader system including pipes, treatment, and billing
